6.75 rsInvalidExpressionScopeDataSet
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidExpressionScopeDataSet is a critical error that occurs if, for a UserSort element, the
UserSort.SortExpressionScope element and the UserSort.SortTarget element refer to scope data
regions that do not share the same DataSet.
